rows.note: Use this as the precise term for a guided missile whose course can be adjusted after launch.

example.english: The missile can still adjust its flight path after launch, so it is much more accurate.
example.traditional: 發射之後仲可以調整飛行方向嘅導彈，準確度高好多。
example.jyutping: faat3 se6 zi1 hau6 zung6 ho2 ji5 tiu4 zing2 fei1 hang4 fong1 hoeng3 ge3 dou6 daan2 zeon2 kok3 dou6 gou1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this broader military term when the missile is being discussed generally rather than specifically as guided.

example.english: The TV news said the military launched a missile.
example.traditional: 電視新聞話軍方發射咗一枚飛彈。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 san1 man4 waa6 gwan1 fong1 faat3 se6 zo2 jat1 mui4 fei1 daan2

rows.note: Use this formal general term for any object thrown or fired through the air as a weapon, including a stone, arrow, or bullet.

example.english: Even this stone can be used as a missile, so don’t throw it around.
example.traditional: 呢粒石都可以當投射物，唔好亂咁掟。
example.jyutping: nei1 lap1 sek6 dou1 ho2 ji5 dong3 tau4 se6 mat6 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam3 deng3
